responsibility: This file implements shared core routines used by both lto1 and lto-dump for reading LTO object content into GCC IR. It owns common front-end initialization, section-table helpers, decl-state decoding, global type canonicalization and type-merging support, symbol/cgraph input finalization, EH personality selection, and LTO memory/statistics reporting, producing a merged in-memory symbol table and tree state ready for either optimization or inspection.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared LTO reader/front-end machinery declared for reuse by both lto1 and lto-dump, including functions such as lto_fe_init, read_cgraph_and_symbols support, reporting, and EH-personality state handling; unlike gcc/lto/lto-common.h, it contains the executable logic and storage, not just declarations.
